items.title: File Beaver County business personal property return
items.description: Utah businesses on the county's rolls return a signed statement of personal property to the county assessor; the state default date is May 15 of the year the assessor requests it (60 days if requested on or after March 16), so use the date printed on the statement. A small-holdings exemption (about $30,100 of taxable value in 2026) must be claimed by filing; late filers pay a penalty of $25 or 10% of the tax, whichever is greater. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state rule applies. The link is the county assessor's home page.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file the return; the personal property tax is billed on the assessed value at the local rate.

penalty.note: 10% of the estimated tax due, but not less than $25, for each statement not filed by May 15 (Utah Code 59-2-307); it may be waived for reasonable cause.
